name: MLflow
description: Platform for tracking machine learning experiments, packaging models, and managing the model registry.

envVars.description: Password for the MLflow Postgres backend store

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    command: "mlflow server --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5000 --backend-store-uri postgresql://mlflow:{{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}@{{serviceName}}-postgres:5432/mlflow --default-artifact-root /mlflow/artifacts"
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/artifacts:/mlflow/artifacts
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: mlflow
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: mlflow
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
